criticalSuccess: The edge traces a perfect arc and bites deep across {bodyPart}.

criticalSuccess.text: The blade runs down {target's} guard and sinks in where it no longer protects.

criticalSuccess: {attacker} chains two cuts; the second leaves a red line across {bodyPart}.

criticalSuccess: The edge comes down from high to low and carves deep across {bodyPart}.

The edge tears through {target's} gear and marks the flesh beneath.

success.text: {attacker} slashes across the guard; the steel finds its mark.

success: A quick cut leaves a slash across {bodyPart}.

success.text: {attacker} cuts under the parry and hits {target} at the edge of the guard.

success: The edge scrapes across {bodyPart} with a rasp of leather.

success.text: {target} parries too high; the blade slips underneath and cuts.

success: {attacker} swings wide and the tip of the blade finds flesh.

failure.text: {target} parries the slash with a bright ring of steel.

failure: {attacker} cuts empty air; {target} has already slipped out of the arc.
The blade slides along {target's} defense without finding a gap.

failure.text: Steel meets steel in a shower of sparks.

failure: {target} bends backward and the slash passes overhead.
The cut is too wide: {target} only needs one step back.

failure.text: The blade snags on {target's} guard and turns away harmlessly.
{attacker} hunts for an opening, but the steel meets only a parry.

failure: A powerful backhand, but {target} saw it coming.

failure.text: The blade trims a lock of hair, nothing more.

failure: {target} intercepts the blade and beats it aside.

failure.text: The edge scores the leather of {target's} gear and goes no further.
